messages:
Srinivas (VP Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: API/Console/Optimize timelines. Can leads confirm targets and main blockers?
Ana (PM): Short summary: API tiering -> GA target end of Q3 (internal beta mid-Q3). Console rerun/debug UI -> early Q4 pending infra work. Optimize suggestion engine (quantization recs) -> prototype now, pilot in Q4.
Ken (Eng): API tiering blocker = quota service migration. Sprint scheduled next week but code review could push timeline ~3w.
Li (DevEx): Please confirm we keep backward-compatible rate-limit headers; we need to avoid SDK breaks.
Ana (PM): Yes, beta will expose old headers + new tier header. SDK teams notified.
Maria (Design): I can run 5 quick usability sessions for rerun UI next week (remote). Want to test copy + primary flows.
Srinivas (VP Product): Thanks. About Optimize: any privacy/KMS concerns for perf traces?
Ken (Eng): Hosted/Dedicated collect anonymized perf metrics only, no raw tokens. Private deployments keep traces on customer infra. We'll add a privacy note.
product-docs-bot: New doc uploaded: https://redwood.docs/roadmaps/q3-q4-draft (timeline draft)
Ana (PM): Action plan: beta invites for API tiering next week if infra holds. I'll update the roadmap doc when infra confirms.
Li (DevEx): @Ana please add an SDK migration snippet & changelog entry. Example snippet: ```curl -i -H 'X-RateLimit-Limit: 200' https://api.redwood/shipping```
Ken (Eng): Note: Dedicated autoscaling interactions with tiered limits may need a short config change. I'll add infra risk section.
Ana (PM): Action items: Ken - confirm infra dates by EOD Wed; Maria - schedule 5 usability sessions; Li - draft SDK changelog; I'll update doc and ping infra leads. :thumbsup:
Srinivas (VP Product): If blockers appear, post here and I'll escalate.
deploy-bot: deploy: roadmap doc push to staging (build 4832)
Ken (Eng): Quota migration sprint confirmed Mon-Fri next week. If reviews pass, mid-Q3 beta is on track.
Ana (PM): Updating the doc now; expect revised timeline by tomorrow morning.
Li (DevEx): I'll draft a partner-facing "what's changing" note.
Maria (Design): Will share usability notes in the doc after sessions.
